question: Which offices may delegate which actions, for how long, and who succeeds an absent or departed handler?
decision: An authorized officer issues a scoped successor/cover mandate for up to 30 days, subject to eligibility and conflicts. On expiry/departure, revoke access immediately and transfer open work without delay; deadline-critical cases receive same-day interim coverage, rather than waiting up to five business days. Record handoff, next action and all deadlines.
originalProposedDecision: Officers delegate case actions to another eligible person for at most 30 days; succession on departure is assigned by an officer within 5 business days, with an interim officer cover.
